Package com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update.scheduling

Interface UpdateScheduler.ScheduledUpdateListener

Enclosing class:
UpdateScheduler
public static interface UpdateScheduler.ScheduledUpdateListener
Listener interface for scheduled update events. Every method has a default no-op implementation so hosts only override what they need.
